title: Investigating cis-regulatory elements and gene expression in multiple tomato varieties using interpretable deep learning.
authors: Ji, Xiang; Wang, Cong; Zhang, He; Gong, Xiuyi; Zhu, Chunyu; Zhao, Yanshen; Liu, Yang; Han, Zhongzhi; He, Hang
journal: TAG. Theoretical and applied genetics. Theoretische und angewandte Genetik
one_liner_zh: 该文用可解释深度学习模型L-CRE预测番茄基因表达并识别顺式调控元件，虽涉及转录因子结合位点但未聚焦TF-DNA三维互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Cis-regulatory elements (CREs) govern gene expression, and the relationship between non-coding regulatory elements and gene expression is inherently complex. To further elucidate how these elements influence gene expression, we refined previous models and developed an interpretable deep learning model, termed L-CRE. By analyzing the flanking regions of genes from four distinct tomato varieties, this model successfully predicted high and low levels of gene expression, achieving a peak accuracy of 86.9%, demonstrating robust performance. To gain deeper insights into the model's predictive mechanisms, we conducted an interpretability analysis, calculating and evaluating the contribution scores of different genomic regions to the prediction outcomes. Through further exploration of these contribution scores, we identified several critical genomic regions that significantly influence the prediction of gene expression levels. Notably, these regions frequently encompass transcription factor binding sites. Moreover, based on the analysis of contribution scores, we successfully identified several experimentally validated regulatory elements. This study not only enhances our understanding of gene regulatory mechanisms in tomatoes but also provides novel insights and methodologies for future research in crop genetic improvement and functional genomics.
abstract_zh: 顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements, CREs）调控基因表达，而非编码调控元件与基因表达之间的关系本质上十分复杂。为进一步阐明这些元件如何影响基因表达，我们优化了先前模型，并开发了一种可解释的深度学习模型，命名为L-CRE。通过分析四个不同番茄品种基因的侧翼区域，该模型成功预测了基因表达的高、低水平，最高准确率达86.9%，展现出稳健性能。为深入理解模型的预测机制，我们进行了可解释性分析，计算并评估了不同基因组区域对预测结果的贡献分数。通过对这些贡献分数的进一步探索，我们识别出若干对基因表达水平预测具有显著影响的关键基因组区域。值得注意的是，这些区域常包含转录因子结合位点。此外，基于贡献分数分析，我们成功鉴定出多个经实验验证的调控元件。本研究不仅增进了我们对番茄基因调控机制的理解，也为未来作物遗传改良和功能基因组学研究提供了新见解与方法。
